title: Sumantra was unable to console Kausalya
introduction: Sumantra was unable to console Kausalya, who lied on the floor due to her extreme grief over her separation from Rama, even though he tries to avert her grief by telling her that Rama can reside in the forest delightfully, by warding off his agony.
closing: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे ष्ष्टितमः सर्गः
Thus completes 60th Chapter of Ayodhya Kanda of the glorious Ramayana of Valmiki, the work of a sage and the oldest epic.

verses.devanagari:
ततः भूत उपसृष्टा इव वेपमाना पुनः पुनः |
धरण्याम् गत सत्त्वा इव कौसल्या सूतम् अब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
tataḥ bhūta upasṛṣṭā iva vepamānā punaḥ punaḥ |
dharaṇyām gata sattvā iva kausalyā sūtam abravīt
verses.translation: Then, Kausalya, trembling again and again, as though possessed by a spirit, and lying on the floor without proper disposition of mind, spoke to Sumantra as follows:

glosses.meaning: as though possessed by a spirit

verses.devanagari:
नय माम् यत्र काकुत्स्थः सीता यत्र च लक्ष्मणः |
तान् विना क्षणम् अपि अत्र जीवितुम् न उत्सहे हि अहम्
verses.iast:
naya mām yatra kākutsthaḥ sītā yatra ca lakṣmaṇaḥ |
tān vinā kṣaṇam api atra jīvitum na utsahe hi aham
verses.translation: "Wherever Rama, Seetha and Lakshmana are there, take me to them. Without them, I do not cherish to live here even for a moment."

verses.devanagari:
निवर्तय रथम् शीघ्रम् दण्डकान् नय माम् अपि |
अथ तान् न अनुगच्चामि गमिष्यामि यम क्षयम्
verses.iast:
nivartaya ratham śīghram daṇḍakān naya mām api |
atha tān na anugaccāmi gamiṣyāmi yama kṣayam
verses.translation: "Turn back the chariot quickly. Take also myself to the forest of Dandaka. Now, if I do not go after them, I shall enter the Death's abode."

glosses.meaning: if I do not go after

verses.devanagari:
बाष्प वेगौपहतया स वाचा सज्जमानया |
इदम् आश्वासयन् देवीम् सूतः प्रान्जलिर् अब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
bāṣpa vegaupahatayā sa vācā sajjamānayā |
idam āśvāsayan devīm sūtaḥ prānjalir abravīt
verses.translation: Sumantra with joined palms and with a voice choked with tears and in faint accents, consoling Kausalya, spoke these words to her.

verses.devanagari:
त्यज शोकम् च मोहम् च सम्भ्रमम् दुह्खजम् तथा |
व्यवधूय च सम्तापम् वने वत्स्यति राघवः
verses.iast:
tyaja śokam ca moham ca sambhramam duhkhajam tathā |
vyavadhūya ca samtāpam vane vatsyati rāghavaḥ
verses.translation: "Abandon grief, delusion and haste born of affliction. Rama, can reside in the forest, warding off anguish."

verses.devanagari:
लक्ष्मणः च अपि रामस्य पादौ परिचरन् वने |
आराधयति धर्मज्ञः पर लोकम् जित इन्द्रियः
verses.iast:
lakṣmaṇaḥ ca api rāmasya pādau paricaran vane |
ārādhayati dharmaGYaḥ para lokam jita indriyaḥ
verses.translation: "Lakshmana too, knowing about a righteous conduct, having subdued his senses and serving the feet of Rama in the forest, is propitiating the other world."

verses.devanagari:
विजने अपि वने सीता वासम् प्राप्य गृहेष्व् इव |
विस्रम्भम् लभते अभीता रामे सम्न्यस्त मानसा
verses.iast:
vijane api vane sītā vāsam prāpya gṛheṣv iva |
visrambham labhate abhītā rāme samnyasta mānasā
verses.translation: "Seetha, getting a dwelling place resembling a house even in a lonely forest, her mind encamped in Rama and being fearless, is acquiring confidence.

verses.devanagari:
न अस्या दैन्यम् कृतम् किंचित् सुसूक्ष्मम् अपि लक्षये |
उचिता इव प्रवासानाम् वैदेही प्रतिभाति मा
verses.iast:
na asyā dainyam kṛtam kiṃcit susūkṣmam api lakṣaye |
ucitā iva pravāsānām vaidehī pratibhāti mā
verses.translation: "Not even very minute depression, even a little, is seen developed in Seetha. It appears to me as though Seetha is accustomed to so many exiles."

verses.devanagari:
नगर उपवनम् गत्वा यथा स्म रमते पुरा |
तथैव रमते सीता निर्जनेषु वनेष्व् अपि
verses.iast:
nagara upavanam gatvā yathā sma ramate purā |
tathaiva ramate sītā nirjaneṣu vaneṣv api
verses.translation: "Seetha is taking delight in the desolate forests in the same manner as she was earlier enjoying in visiting gardens in the city."

verses.devanagari:
बाला इव रमते सीता बाल चन्द्र निभ आनना |
रामा रामे हि अदीन आत्मा विजने अपि वने सती
verses.iast:
bālā iva ramate sītā bāla candra nibha ānanā |
rāmā rāme hi adīna ātmā vijane api vane satī
verses.translation: "Seetha, a charming woman with her face resembling a full moon and with her mind absorbed in Rama, even though staying in a lonely forest, is enjoying it like a little girl."

glosses.meaning: having her face resembling a full moon

verses.devanagari:
तत् गतम् हृदयम् हि अस्याः तत् अधीनम् च जीवितम् |
अयोध्या अपि भवेत् तस्या राम हीना तथा वनम्
verses.iast:
tat gatam hṛdayam hi asyāḥ tat adhīnam ca jīvitam |
ayodhyā api bhavet tasyā rāma hīnā tathā vanam
verses.translation: "Seetha's heart is directed towards Rama. Her life also is dependent on him. Even if Ayodhya is without Rama, then it becomes a forest to her."

verses.devanagari:
परि पृच्चति वैदेही ग्रामामः च नगराणि च |
गतिम् दृष्ट्वा नदीनाम् च पादपान् विविधान् अपि
रामम् हि लक्ष्मनम् वापि पृष्ट्वा जानाति जानती |
अयोध्याक्रोशमात्रे तु विहारमिव संश्रिता
verses.iast:
pari pṛccati vaidehī grāmāmḥ ca nagarāṇi ca |
gatim dṛṣṭvā nadīnām ca pādapān vividhān api
rāmam hi lakṣmanam vāpi pṛṣṭvā jānāti jānatī |
ayodhyākrośamātre tu vihāramiva saṃśritā
verses.translation: "As if only a couple of miles away from Ayodhya and as being in a garden there, Seetha on seeing villages, towns, movement of rivers, and various types of trees, enquires with Rama or Lakshmana and Knows well about them."

glosses.meaning: As if only a couple of miles away from Ayodhya

verses.devanagari:
इदमेव स्मराम्यस्याः सहसैवोपजल्पितम् |
कैकेयीसंश्रितम् वाक्यम् नेदानीम् प्रतिभाति माम्
verses.iast:
idameva smarāmyasyāḥ sahasaivopajalpitam |
kaikeyīsaṃśritam vākyam nedānīm pratibhāti mām
verses.translation: "I am remembering only these incidents about Seetha. It does not flash to my mind now of the words hurriedly spoken of by Seetha about Kaikeyi."

verses.devanagari:
ध्वंसयित्वा तु तद्वाक्यम् प्रमादात्पर्युपस्थितम् |
ह्लदनम् वचनम् सूतो देव्या मधुरमब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
dhvaṃsayitvā tu tadvākyam pramādātparyupasthitam |
hladanam vacanam sūto devyā madhuramabravīt
verses.translation: Expunging the remarks spoken by Seetha about Kaikeyi coming almost nearer to his lips by inadvertence, Sumantra spoke only delightful and sweet words to Kausalya.

glosses.meaning: those words (spoken by Seetha about Kaikeyi)

verses.devanagari:
अध्वना वात वेगेन सम्भ्रमेण आतपेन च |
न हि गच्चति वैदेह्याः चन्द्र अंशु सदृशी प्रभा
verses.iast:
adhvanā vāta vegena sambhrameṇa ātapena ca |
na hi gaccati vaidehyāḥ candra aṃśu sadṛśī prabhā
verses.translation: "Seetha's radiance resembling a moon's gleam is not fading away due to her travel in the forest or due to the velocity of wind or because of her bewilderment or due to heat of the sun."

glosses.meaning: or due to heat of the sun.

verses.devanagari:
सदृशम् शत पत्रस्य पूर्ण चन्द्र उपम प्रभम् |
वदनम् तत् वदान्याया वैदेह्या न विकम्पते
verses.iast:
sadṛśam śata patrasya pūrṇa candra upama prabham |
vadanam tat vadānyāyā vaidehyā na vikampate
verses.translation: "That face of altruistic Seetha resembling a lotus flower, whose lustre is similar to that of a full moon, did not become changed."

glosses.meaning: whose lustre is similar to that of a full moon

verses.devanagari:
अलक्त रस रक्त अभाव् अलक्त रस वर्जितौ |
अद्य अपि चरणौ तस्याः पद्म कोश सम प्रभौ
verses.iast:
alakta rasa rakta abhāv alakta rasa varjitau |
adya api caraṇau tasyāḥ padma kośa sama prabhau
verses.translation: "Her feet, which even though no longer painted with vermilion, still looks red as Alakta (red juice obtained from resin of certain trees), with lustre equal to that of red lotus buds."

glosses.meaning: which even though no longer painted with vermilion
looks red as Alakta (red juice obtained from resin of certain trees)
with a lustre equal to that of red lotus buds.

verses.devanagari:
नूपुर उद्घुष्ट हेला इव खेलम् गच्चति भामिनी |
इदानीम् अपि वैदेही तत् रागा न्यस्त भूषणा
verses.iast:
nūpura udghuṣṭa helā iva khelam gaccati bhāminī |
idānīm api vaidehī tat rāgā nyasta bhūṣaṇā
verses.translation: "Seetha, sporting her tinkling anklets, walks playfully. Even now, Seetha dons her ornaments, as a mark of Her passion towards Rama."

glosses.meaning: as a mark of passion towards Rama.

verses.devanagari:
गजम् वा वीक्ष्य सिम्हम् वा व्याघ्रम् वा वनम् आश्रिता |
न आहारयति सम्त्रासम् बाहू रामस्य संश्रिता
verses.iast:
gajam vā vīkṣya simham vā vyāghram vā vanam āśritā |
na āhārayati samtrāsam bāhū rāmasya saṃśritā
verses.translation: "Seetha who stays in the forest, takes refuge in the arms of Rama and hence does not give Herself to fear, even by seeing an elephant or a lion or a tiger."

verses.devanagari:
न शोच्याः ते न च आत्मा ते शोच्यो न अपि जन अधिपः |
इदम् हि चरितम् लोके प्रतिष्ठास्यति शाश्वतम्
verses.iast:
na śocyāḥ te na ca ātmā te śocyo na api jana adhipaḥ |
idam hi caritam loke pratiṣṭhāsyati śāśvatam
verses.translation: "There is no need to pity them nor us nor the king too. This story will thrive in the world forever."

glosses.meaning: there is no need to pity

verses.devanagari:
विधूय शोकम् परिहृष्ट मानसा |
महर्षि याते पथि सुव्यवस्थिताः |
वने रता वन्य फल अशनाः पितुः |
शुभाम् प्रतिज्ञाम् परिपालयन्ति ते
verses.iast:
vidhūya śokam parihṛṣṭa mānasā |
maharṣi yāte pathi suvyavasthitāḥ |
vane ratā vanya phala aśanāḥ pituḥ |
śubhām pratiGYām paripālayanti te
verses.translation: "Abandoning grief, possessing cheerful minds, settling well in the path followed by great sages, delighting in the forest-life and eating fruits of the forest, they are keeping up the promise given to their father."

glosses.meaning: eating fruits obtained in the forest

verses.devanagari:
तथा अपि सूतेन सुयुक्त वादिना |
निवार्यमाणा सुत शोक कर्शिता |
न चैव देवी विरराम कूजितात् |
प्रिय इति पुत्र इति च राघव इति च
verses.iast:
tathā api sūtena suyukta vādinā |
nivāryamāṇā suta śoka karśitā |
na caiva devī virarāma kūjitāt |
priya iti putra iti ca rāghava iti ca
verses.translation: Even if averted thus by Sumantra, who is speaking appropriately well, being emaciated by sorrow for her son, could not stop crying, "O, my dear son Rama!"

glosses.meaning: being emaciated by the sorrow for her son
